statements.sql:
SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "line_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "line_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."lines"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("lts") as min_date,
  MAX("lts") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."lines"

SELECT "order_id", "ts"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."orders"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ts" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "qty", "lts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."lines"
  ON "order_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "lts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "lts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "lts" <= ?
AND "lts" > ?

)

FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."users"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "line_id", "order_id", "qty", "lts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."lines"
  ON "order_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "lts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "lts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "lts" <= ?
  AND "lts" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "lts" DESC, "line_id"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "lts" DESC, "line_id"
